name: services/prgroups/descriptors
description: Get information on multiple descriptors of primary groups.
brief_description: Get information on multiple descriptors of primary groups.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector must contain subset of primary fields, which are described in the returns section of descriptor method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A dictionary mapping descriptor IDs to dictionaries describing the descriptors (as returned by descriptor method). If specified descriptor could not be found, null is returned instead of a dictionary.
